539-3821-4679-6797-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-6797-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

2026-2645-3430-3478.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
2026-2645-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

553-1470-5049.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Leyline of Anticipation.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

471-7839.notablePrerequisites: Pestilence Demon is indestructible, has protection from black, or has protection from creatures.
471-7839.description:
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each player and creature.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6822-7704.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Doc Samson
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1322-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
1322-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1545-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-2869-7071.description:
Activate Ticking Gnomes by sacrificing it.
When Ticking Gnomes dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Ticking Gnomes that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Ticking Gnomes ability.
Repeat using the Ticking Gnomes token

5147-5961--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

147-6797-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-6797-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2334-4377-5531.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
2334-4377-5531.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using Soulherder.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4067-6281-7252.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Grave Sifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Grave Sifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Grave Sifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

2804-3490-4050-4369.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2804-3490-4050-4369.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Witty Roastmaster triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Witty Roastmaster triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Witty Roastmaster triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

4017-4659-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-4659-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

1953-4918-6320.easyPrerequisites: You have at least {E}{E}{E} plus an additional {E}{E} if you control no other tokens or copies of Lightning Runner.
1953-4918-6320.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1953-4918-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Lightning Runner.
Resolve the Brudiclad trigger, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact token and then causing each token you control to become a copy of the Lightning Runner token.
Declare all Lightning Runners you control as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve all but one Lightning Runner ability, causing you to get {E}{E} for each ability and choosing not to pay each time.
Resolve the final Lightning Runner ability, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase. At the beginning of that phase, Saheeli and Brudiclad trigger.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat from step 3.

2558-2921-3490-5231.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3372-4927-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4927-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

4499-5727-6252.description:
Activate Boommobile's crew ability by tapping Emiel, causing Boommobile to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Boommobile.
When Boommobile enters the battlefield, it and The Prydwen trigger.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight creature token.
Resolve the Boommobile trigger, adding four mana of any color that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Boommobile's crew ability by tapping the Human Knight, causing Boommobile to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1170-1418-3389-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-5147-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2178-5147-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Devil.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

5220-5256-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: The Lhurgoyf has base power 1 or greater, if needed.
5220-5256-5659--33.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard on top of your library. 
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill the Lhurgoyf from the top of your library.
Disa the Restless' first ability triggers, returning the milled Lhurgoyf from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

803-1641-2034-5115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

3209-4214-4772-4871.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saproling tokens.

224-280-4913-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

570-618-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
570-618-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faeburrow Elder with haste.
Activate the Faeburrow Elder token by tapping it, adding at least {1}{R}{G}{W}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1679-1722-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1679-1722-4050.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Dire Undercurrents' first ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Resolve the Dire Undercurrents trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

965-2464.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other blue creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Crackleburr does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has one or two lore counters on it.
965-2464.description:
Activate Crackleburr and two other blue creatures you control by tapping them, adding {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
Activate Crackleburr's second ability by paying {U/R}{U/R} and untapping it and the two blue creatures, targeting any creature.
Repeat.
